_doc: Ink pellet (stun gun) tables. StartStunGun 0x432330: pellet x = SubX + spawn_dx[SubCell], y = SubY + spawn_dy[SubCell], direction = dir_by_subcell[SubCell] (index into step tables; 3 = no motion: splashes at once). UpdateStunGun 0x4323f0 moves it 3 steps/frame of (step_dx[dir], step_dy[dir]) px = up to 24 px/frame; it is removed outside x 1..0x26f, y 0x11..0x13f, and 'hits' (starts the splash animation, frames 1..3) when the tile at ((x-8)>>4, (y-0x18)>>4) in the 38x18 map has flag 0x40. Splash frame k is drawn from the ink bundle (16) picture k at (x+splash_dx[k], y+splash_dy[k]). Max 2 pellets in flight.
